name: Chutler
ability: You start knowing how many pairs of evil players there are. You may only vote if a pair of people vote too.

name: Washerbutler
ability: You start knowing that 1 of 2 players is a particular Townsfolk. You may only vote if none of them votes.
firstNightReminder: Show the Townsfolk character token. Point to both the *TOWNSFOLK* and *WRONG* players.

name: Butinvestigator
ability: You start knowing that 1 of 2 players is a particular Minion. You can only vote if one of them is voting too.
firstNightReminder: Show the Minion character token. Point to both the *MINION* and *WRONG* players.

name: Butarian
ability: You start knowing that 1 of 2 players is a particular Outsider. You may only vote if at least one of them is voting too.
firstNightReminder: Show the Outsider character token. Point to both the *OUTSIDER* and *WRONG* players.

name: Butler Teller
ability: Each night, choose 2 players: you learn if either is a Demon. There is a good player that registers as a Demon to you. You may only vote if you learn no.
firstNightReminder: The Fortune Teller chooses 2 players. Nod if either is the Demon (or the *RED HERRING*).
otherNightReminder: The Fortune Teller chooses 2 players. Nod if either is the Demon (or the *RED HERRING*).

name: Butpath
ability: Each night, you learn how many of your 2 alive neighbors are evil. You can only vote if both of them are voting too.

name: Buttaker
ability: Each night*, you learn which character died by execution today. You may only vote if a ghost is voting too.
otherNightReminder: If a player was executed today, show their character token.

name: Bunk
ability: Each night*, choose a player (not yourself): they are safe from the Demon tonight. You may only vote if the protected player is voting too.

name: Butlayer
ability: Once per game, during the day, publicly choose a player: if they are the Demon, they die. You may only vote if you have used your ability.

name: Boldier
ability: You are safe from the demon. You can only vote if nobody is on the block.

name: Buttkeeper
ability: If you die at night, you are woken to choose a player: you learn their character. You may only vote if someone died yesterday.
otherNightReminder: If the Butler keeper died tonight, the Butler keeper chooses a player. Show that player's character token.

name: Bayor
ability: If only 3 players live & no execution occurs, your team wins. If you die at night, another player might die instead. You may only vote if there are more than 3 players alive.

name: Burgin
ability: The 1st time you are nominated, if the nominator is a Townsfolk, they are executed immediately. You may only vote if someone nominated you today.

name: Butlerler
ability: Each night, choose a player (not yourself): tomorrow, you may only vote if they are voting too
flavor: Yes, sir... No, sir... Certainly, sir.

jinxes.reason: If the Cannibal gains the Qutler ability, the Cannibal learns this.
If the Organ Grinder is causing eyes closed voting, the Qutler may raise their hand to vote but their vote is only counted if their master voted too.

name: Drunkler
ability: You think you're a townsfolk but you're not, you are the drunk. You don't have any restrictions but(ler) you think you do.

name: Butcluse
ability: You might register as evil & as a Minion or Demon, even if dead. You may only vote if 2 or more people are voting.

name: Baint
ability: If you die by execution, your team loses. You may only vote once per day.

name: Butoisoner
ability: Each night, choose a player: they are poisoned tonight and tomorrow day. You may only vote if your target voted too.

name: Sby
ability: Each night, you see the Grimoire. You might register as good & as a Townsfolk or Outsider, even if dead. You may only vote if an evil player is also voting.
firstNightReminder: Show the Grimoire for as long as the Spy needs.
otherNightReminder: Show the Grimoire for as long as the Spy needs.

name: Butlerwoman
ability: If there are 5 or more players alive & the Demon dies, you become the Demon. (Travellers don't count). You may only vote if the demon votes or when they demon is dead.
otherNightReminder: If the Scarlet Woman became the Demon today, show them the *YOU ARE* token, then the Demon token.

name: Buton
ability: There are extra Outsiders in play. You may only vote if 2 or more players are voting too. [+2 Outsiders]

name: Bimp
ability: Each night*, choose a player: they die. If you kill yourself this way, a Minion becomes the Imp. You don't have any voting restrictions.
otherNightReminder: The Imp chooses a player. :reminder: If the Imp chose themselves: Replace 1 alive Minion token with a spare Imp token. Put the old Imp to sleep. Wake the new Imp. Show the *YOU ARE* token, then show the Imp token.

name: Master Butler (optional)
ability: Each night* an alive player is the Master. They have no voting restriction today.
flavor: One master butler to rule them all
otherNightReminder: Tell the player they are the new master.
